name: Knox County, IL
findings: Knox County has 212 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Knox County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Knox County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
